metadata.title: Looking ahead to Micron's guidance - MarketWatch

content.text:
57 min ago
Looking ahead to Micron's guidance
To exceed the FactSet consensus with its guidance, Micron needs to project more than $25.59 in August-quarter adjusted earnings per share and $43.4 billion in revenue.
But it might take more than that to send the stock higher. Susquehanna analyst Mehdi Hosseini wrote earlier this week that the buy-side bogey for guidance is "set toward the upper end of the $25-$30 EPS range."
